text:
sahil: HelixHealth (enterprise, Dedicated) reporting regression — p95 token latency jumped from ~200ms to ~800ms since 2026-03-19 02:30 UTC deploy. They're seeing a revenue hit and asked for timeline. Support ticket: https://redwood.internal/s/TICKET-1423 (redacted). Can we triage?

maria: adding product to thread. What's their SLA tier and do we have any repro/runbook?

tess (Support): they're on Enterprise S1 SLA. Logs attached in the ticket. No customer-side config changes. Only change on our side was we rolled redwood-13b-v1-quant into their dedicated pool ~02:30 UTC.

kai: likely quantization perf regression or kernel selection fallback. Need per-token timing traces, KV cache hit rate, batch size distribution, and any kernel fallback logs.

aj: I can pull infra metrics (queue length, GPU utilization, pod restarts). Assigning to eng-runtime to lead.

maria: prioritization? Customer is threatening to pause traffic if SLA not met. Sales, how critical?

sahil: Critical — they're seeing major slowdown affecting checkout flows. They said target p95 <= 350ms. Legal says they want a mitigation plan within 24h; otherwise escalation in 72h.

lee (Eng-Platform): quick mitigation we can do now: route 30% of HelixHealth traffic to hosted non-quant model (redwood-13b-v1) and bump dedicated pool min nodes by 1 to reduce queueing. Flip via routing policy: 

```json
{
  "match": {"customer_id": "helix"},
  "route": [
    {"model": "redwood-13b-v1", "pct": 30},
    {"model": "redwood-13b-v1-quant", "pct": 70}
  ],
  "ttl": "24h"
}
```

kai: I'll pull runtime traces and run a perf repro on a staging copy. If kernel fallback is happening we may need a pin or revert for the quant build. Estimate 6-8h for root cause, 24-48h for a production-safe patch.

maria: proposed acceptance criteria for the fix: 
- p95 <= 350ms for HelixHealth under their observed load in prod/staging 
- no significant regressions for top 10 customers (spot-check) 
- rollout plan with canary + rollback in Console 
- customer sign-off on restored SLA

tess (Support): I informed customer we'll provide a mitigation within 2h and an RCA/ETA within 8h. They're ok with staged routing as a temporary measure.

sahil: please add this to product backlog as urgent (P1). If fix >72h we escalate to exec chain.

aj: collected infra metrics — queue latency spike at ~02:28 UTC correlates with kernel-fallback logs and increased batch accumulation. Uploading metrics: https://ci.redwood/metrics/helix-queue-2162345678 (redacted).

kai: starting perf repro now. Will validate KV cache hit rates and rerun kernel path selection tests.

deploy-bot: Canary routing change scheduled by lee at 2162348900 (approx in 5 minutes).

maria: owners: kai (eng-runtime) -> root cause & patch; lee (eng-platform) -> routing mitigation; tess -> customer comms; maria -> product PRD & backlog. Target: mitigation live in 2h, RCA/ETA in 8h. :thumbsup:

sahil: thanks — ping oncall if anything escalates. @aj please prep notes for postmortem if needed.

kai: will update thread with first-pass trace and perf numbers within 2h.
